name: @lattice/example-island
description: ISLAND — a gallery exhibit. Terrain, a shoreline, trees, and a full day/night cycle in ninety seconds.
$comment: Six of nine, and the three that are absent are absent for reasons rather than by oversight. @lattice/sim has no economy to run: this exhibit has no numbers. @lattice/persist has nothing to save, per docs/GALLERY.md, which forbids an exhibit a state that outlives the tab. @lattice/audio is the one that is a finding — an island with surf, wind and gulls is exactly the exhibit that wants a bed, and it is left out only because a page that starts making noise before a visitor has touched it is worse than a silent one, and the gallery has no shared answer yet for the unlock gesture. @lattice/input is here through the shared bootstrap rather than by name: the camera is the whole interaction.
